nodes.label: Rationale: DB init/close wired to onAuthStateChanged
Rationale: intentional logout guard blocks silent re-auth
Rationale: single-session lock fails open on error
Rationale: pullProfileFromCloud before setUser prevents admin redirect flash
Rationale: stale-while-revalidate — cached data first, then Drive fetch
Rationale: push on milestones (tab/claim switch, close, hide) not continuously
Rationale: visibilitychange fires reliably before freeze/close unlike beforeunload
Security note: backupProfileToDrive writes API keys to user's own Drive intentionally
Rationale: delta sync from lastSyncTimestamp, full sync fallback on first login
Rationale: stale-URL guard prevents reload from URL after closeClaim clears store
Rationale: use history.pushState not router.push to avoid full reload in static export
Rationale: heartbeat + deviceId mismatch detection forces sign-out on kick
Rationale: block report when deduction reason can't be inferred from data alone
Rationale: pre-classify unambiguous rows deterministically to cut AI token usage
Rationale: only send anomalous rows to AI (surgical selection) to minimise tokens
Rationale: keep largest non-zero value for total fields across page chunks
Rationale: sequential queue prevents API rate limiting per user request
Rationale: Groq 8K TPM cap budgets prompt to 4500 tokens
Rationale: text-mode chunk retried as vision on PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE
Rationale: skip context snippets for high-volume tabular docs to halve output tokens
Rationale: conflict flagged only when values genuinely disagree, never unset fields
Rationale: PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE re-thrown immediately, rotating keys won't help
Rationale: key rotation on 429/401, auto-fallback across providers
Rationale: clears Drive/profile/claim-list state, leaves IndexedDB and Firestore intact
Rationale: IRDA/industry CTL threshold 75% of IDV, surveyor makes final call via UI toggle
Legacy travelExpenses fallback keeps old claims totaling correctly
Use pre-GST billedTaxable so negotiated savings aren't distorted by GST
insuredPays floored at zero — insurer never owes insured more than garage bill
Never hand numeric slash dates to new Date() — avoids US MM/DD/YYYY misread
Self-explaining categories never block; judgment-call categories require a remark
Silent auth failure never disconnects — cached token in localStorage may still be valid
Always show account picker so surveyor consciously chooses the linked Drive account
401 response clears connected state so the Drive gate re-engages
Upload never fails silently — queues to IndexedDB for retry and always toasts
Serialize every Drive backup through one promise chain — duplicate-safe against concurrent triggers
Idempotent duplicate-safe backup sweep; skips already-current claims; failures heal next call
Claim backup is best-effort and never throws — Firestore remains source of truth
ponytail: deleted claim's Drive folder (claim.json with PII) not cleaned up — deferred, tracked as F5
Roll pull cursor back by clock-skew margin so a laggy device's claim isn't skipped; re-fetch is harmless
Refuse overwrite only when cloud is strictly newer — optimistic-concurrency guard
Photos excluded from Firestore — too large; local-only storage
Remote must not overwrite unpushed local edits — dirty = updatedAt newer than lastPushed
Signatures, stamps and API keys stay local/Drive-only, never pushed to cloud profile
Version-guarded write refuses if cloud has moved ahead — no caller changes needed, conflicts become harmless
Option B recovery: stash refused local copy, adopt newer remote, notify surveyor — nothing lost
Session is LIVE only while heartbeat is fresh; crashed/closed tab goes stale so next device can claim without a fight
Release session only if this device still owns it — never delete another device's force-claimed doc; non-fatal on error
Device UUID persisted in localStorage so same-device re-login avoids a false conflict
Flush all dirty claims to cloud on logout/kick so no unsynced work is left behind
Local disk read never throws — callers fall back to the Worker on any failure
Always show Google account picker so logout feels real instead of silent re-selection
API key must come from env/CI secrets, never committed; public config values are safe to commit; keys are restricted by Firestore Rules + Auth
mailto: hand-off avoids API keys, quotas, and backend dependencies
Rationale: per-user IndexedDB for shared-PC isolation
Rationale: pushTracking guards against remote overwriting locally-dirty claims
Rationale: recoveredClaims is the Option B stash for superseded sync-conflict copies
Rationale: driveTracking is device-local knowledge of Drive backup status
Rationale: Firestore vault push must succeed, Drive photo flush is best-effort
Rationale: receivedDocsAtSync change detection can only under-count, never false-mark synced
Rationale: multi-sheet workbook generated for IRDAI annual regulatory return submission
Rationale: statutory 'issued without prejudice' disclaimer subject to policy T&C
Rationale: 'compact' scale is a guaranteed no-op baseline for backward compatibility
Rationale: desktop gold-standard reference HTML files are never modified; builders are pixel-perfect ports
Rationale: Sync bridge client is read-only, authenticated via per-surveyor bearer token
Rationale: report-utils.ts is the single source of truth shared across print builders (sync checklist)
Why numeric dates must resolve DD-MM-YYYY before new Date()
Why activeTab is excluded from ui-store persistence
Ponytail: 2-digit fiscal year vs sequence number ambiguity
Why claim-store exists (replaces legacy window.* globals)
